const $parseRaw = (raw, empty) => { if (raw === undefined || raw === null || raw === '') return JSON.parse(empty); if (typeof raw === 'string') return JSON.parse(raw); if (typeof raw === 'object' && (raw.socket || raw._readableState)) throw new Error('Respuesta de Supabase no legible'); return raw; };
return $input.all().flatMap((item,i)=>{const r=$parseRaw(item.json.body, 'null');return (Array.isArray(r)?(r.length?r:[{}]):[r]).map(json=>({json,pairedItem:{item:i}}));});
